title: 2026 cohort completion ceremony
summary: An announcement recognising the work and achievements of Foreign Africa’s 2026 cohort, with Prof. Debrenna Agbényiga listed as guest speaker.
details: The announcement invited the community to recognise the achievements and work of Foreign Africa’s associates.
Prof. Debrenna Agbényiga, Chairperson of the Advisory Council, was listed as guest speaker.

title: Beyond the Logo: Building Brands Investors and Governments Trust
summary: The EDWS Session 4 announcement outlined brand credibility, investor confidence and institutional trust.
details: The announcement named Dr. Temitope Falade as speaker and Hildana Mesai as facilitator.
Topics included executive communications, reputation, brand governance, digital engagement and stakeholder trust.

title: Funding Your Startup — Grants, Debt, Equity & Beyond
summary: The EDWS Session 2 announcement introduced funding options, startup readiness and funder expectations for early-stage businesses.
details: The published session overview named Audrey Simbiso Chidawanyika as session lead and Abdul-Razak Musah as facilitator.
The announced format combined a presentation, practical funding exercise and live questions.
Topics included grants, debt, equity, funding readiness and matching finance to a business’s stage and needs.
